verdict.rationale: Stripe Invoicing documents automatic reminders and payment retries for overdue or failed invoices, configurable email notifications, and branding for customer-facing emails and hosted invoices. That covers the automated, branded email part of a dunning sequence. Final-state handling is only shown as an optional change of an unpaid invoice to void or uncollectible, not as configurable cancel-vs-unpaid rules. Missing for 10: in-app banners, configurable grace periods, automated final-state rules (cancel vs unpaid), detail on sequence/retry schedule configuration, independent corroboration.
